warnings.text: PoCL on Windows shows up as an OpenCL device but computes nothing, so installing it does not help.

reasons.no_device: No CPU OpenCL device was found.
reasons.smoke_test_failed: The CPU OpenCL runtime failed its test calculation.
reasons.smoke_test_timeout: The CPU OpenCL runtime's test calculation timed out.
reasons.pocl_windows: PoCL on Windows cannot run BEMPP calculations.

windows.summary: On computers without a supported graphics-card solver, WG's BEMPP solver runs on the CPU. Installing a CPU OpenCL runtime makes it much faster. It still works without one, more slowly.

steps.label: Intel CPU OpenCL runtime
steps.note: Intel's CPU runtime officially supports Intel processors; it has also worked on AMD processors in our testing. If no OpenCL device works, WG falls back to its slower numba engine.

linux.summary: On computers without a supported graphics-card solver, WG's BEMPP solver runs on the CPU. Installing a CPU OpenCL runtime makes it much faster. It still works without one, more slowly.

steps.label: PoCL CPU OpenCL runtime
steps.note: Install your distribution's PoCL CPU runtime package.

steps.label: Intel CPU OpenCL runtime
steps.note: Alternatively, install Intel's CPU runtime through your distribution or Intel's packages.
